reason: The runner of three wave-2 captures was stopped from outside: the coding session that launched it ends background commands after about 30 minutes. Neither the agents nor the 3600 s attempt timeout stopped anything.
rule: `capture ADAPTER REPEAT --resume` continues a capture that has started.json but no capture.json. Every task with a receipt is a finished attempt and is kept as it is. The attempt that was running when the runner stopped has no receipt; its container is removed, any leftover output or transcript of it is deleted, and it runs again from the source like any other attempt. Each resumption is recorded in resumed-N.json (time and the receipts kept) and listed in capture.json. Captures are now run from a terminal without that limit.
